verdicts.quote: “Authenticate data and account API requests with your Waterfall API key in the x-api-key header.”

verdicts.quote: “You need a Waterfall API key… Contact the team (support@waterfall.io) for access and pricing.”
verdicts.reason: Keys and pricing are obtained by contacting the team; no self‑serve sign‑up is shown.

verdicts.quote: “## Endpoints … Prospector … Search Contact … Contact Enrichment … Phone Enrichment … Company Enrichment … Job Change … Email Verification … Account Reporting … API Key Management.”
verdicts.reason: The docs list roughly a dozen distinct APIs across search, enrichment, verification, and account tools—more than a handful, but not “dozens+ resources.”

verdicts.quote: “Waterfall provides two skills: one for making API calls during a task, and one for creating integration code you maintain.”
verdicts.reason: The vendor documents “agent skills” but does not mention an official MCP server; no primary-source confirmation found either way.

verdicts.quote: “Contact the team (support@waterfall.io) for API access and pricing.”
verdicts.reason: Composio can build against the documented API, but obtaining credentials/pricing requires outreach to sales/support.
